image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a pelican standing in shallow water. The bird is facing left, with its head cropped at the top of the frame. It features white plumage on the neck and chest, transitioning to dark grey/black flight feathers on the visible wing. The distinctive long bill with a pale pinkish gular pouch is prominent. The background consists of blue water and a distant shoreline.
